name: lq3151_volume_guard
comment: ANCHOR: LQ3151_VOLUME_GUARD — heavy writes (worktrees, agent temp, test output, caches, scratch) live on the
verified /data volume, and they fail clearly when it is not mounted. The guard proves the mount point, the
filesystem UUID, the sentinel and a different st_dev from /, per path; scripts/new-worktree.sh refuses before
git runs and never falls back to root. Synthetic temp roots only: the real /data is never written.
